botpasswords-summary: Furayaasha sirta ah ee bot-ka waxay oggolaanayaan in akoon isticmaale lagu galo iyada oo loo marayo API-ga iyadoo aan la isticmaalin aqoonsiyada gelitaanka ee ugu waaweyn ee akoonka. Xuquuqda isticmaalaha ee la heli karo marka lagu galo furaha sirta ah ee bot-ka waa la xaddidi karaa. Haddii aadan garanayn sababta aad tan u samayn lahayd, waa in aadan samayn. Qofna waligiis yuusan kaa codsan inaad samayso mid ka mid ah kuwan oo aad siiso.
botpasswords-disabled: Furayaasha sirta ah ee bot-ka waa naafo.
botpasswords-no-central-id: Si aad u isticmaasho furayaasha sirta ah ee bot-ka, waa inaad gashan tahay akoon dhexe.
botpasswords-existing: Furayaasha sirta ah ee bot-ka ee jira
botpasswords-createnew: Abuur furaha sirta ah ee bot-ka cusub
botpasswords-editexisting: Wax ka beddel furaha sirta ah ee bot-ka jira
botpasswords-label-needsreset: (waa in furaha sirta dib loo dejiyo)
botpasswords-label-resetpassword: Dib u deji furaha sirta ah
botpasswords-help-grants: Deequhu waxay oggolaanayaan helitaanka xuquuqda uu horey u haysto akoonkaaga isticmaalaha. Awoodsiinta deeq halkan kama siinayso helitaanka xuquuqo uusan akoonkaaga isticmaaluhu si kale u lahayn. Ka eeg [[Special:ListGrants|jadwalka deeqaha]] si aad u hesho macluumaad dheeraad ah. Deeqaha khatarta leh waa la calaamadeeyay. Deeqaha aan la calaamadin guud ahaan way adag tahay in si xun loo isticmaalo marka bot-ka ay la wareegto qof leh ujeeddo xaasidnimo ah. Deeqaha leh khatarta burburinta ({{int:grantriskgroup-vandalism}}) waxaa loo isticmaali karaa inay keenaan carqalad u baahan dadaal badan si loo nadiifiyo. Deeqaha leh khatarta amniga ({{int:grantriskgroup-security}}) waxay sababi karaan waxyeello joogto ah (sida xatooyada xog gaar ah). Deeqaha gudaha ({{int:grantriskgroup-internal}}) badanaa waxaa isticmaala oo keliya maamulaha goobta. Fadlan ha codsan deeqo khatar leh haddii aadan runtii u baahnayn.
botpasswords-bad-appid: Magaca bot-ka "$1" ma aha mid sax ah.
botpasswords-toolong-restrictions: Waxaa la geliyay cinwaanno IP ama xadad aad u badan.
botpasswords-toolong-grants: Waxaa la doortay deeqo aad u badan.
botpasswords-insert-failed: Ku darista magaca bot-ka "$1" way fashilantay. Ma hore ayaa loo daray?
botpasswords-update-failed: Cusboonaysiinta magaca bot-ka "$1" way fashilantay. Ma la tirtiray?
botpasswords-created-title: Furaha sirta ah ee bot-ka waa la abuuray
botpasswords-created-body: Furaha sirta ah ee bot-ka ee magaca bot-ka "$1" ee {{GENDER:$2|isticmaalaha}} "$2" waa la abuuray.
botpasswords-updated-title: Furaha sirta ah ee bot-ka waa la cusboonaysiiyay
botpasswords-updated-body: Furaha sirta ah ee bot-ka ee magaca bot-ka "$1" ee {{GENDER:$2|isticmaalaha}} "$2" waa la cusboonaysiiyay.
botpasswords-deleted-title: Furaha sirta ah ee bot-ka waa la tirtiray
botpasswords-deleted-body: Furaha sirta ah ee bot-ka ee magaca bot-ka "$1" ee {{GENDER:$2|isticmaalaha}} "$2" waa la tirtiray.
botpasswords-newpassword:
Furaha sirta ah ee cusub ee lagu geli karo $1 waa $2. Fadlan kaydi tan si aad mustaqbalka ugu tixraacdo.
(Bot-kii hore ee u baahan magaca gelitaanka inuu la mid noqdo magaca isticmaalaha ugu dambeeya, waxaad sidoo kale isticmaali kartaa $3 sida magaca isticmaalaha iyo $4 sida furaha sirta ah.)
botpasswords-restriction-failed: Xannibaadaha furaha sirta ah ee bot-ka ayaa ka hor istaagaya gelitaankan.
botpasswords-invalid-name: Magaca isticmaalaha la cayimay kuma jiro kala soocaha furaha sirta ah ee bot-ka ("$1").
botpasswords-not-exist: Isticmaalaha "$1" ma laha furaha sirta ah ee bot-ka oo la yiraahdo "$2".
botpasswords-needs-reset: Furaha sirta ah ee bot-ka ee magaca bot-ka "$2" ee {{GENDER:$1|isticmaalaha}} "$1" waa in dib loo dejiyaa.
botpasswords-locked: Ma geli kartid adigoo isticmaalaya furaha sirta ah ee bot-ka maadaama akoonkaaga la qufulay.
